Thus petitioner who is arraigned as accused No.5 is seeking quashing of criminal proceedings against him on the ground that except the fact that he is the cousin of accused No.1,he has nothing to do with the allegations made in the complainant.
Unnecessarily he has been implicated.
6. From the complainant averments it is evident that the marriage of accused No.1 and respondent No.2 was celebrated on 12.01.2023.
Serious allegation have been made by complainant against accused No.1 and his immediate family members.

However, petitioner who is a NC:
2025:KHC:24345 HC-KAR cousin of accused No.1 is not residing with him and there are no allegation against him.
In the complaint, the complainant has specified that the accused No.1 to 6 which includes the petitioner and broker.

However, there are no allegation against the petitioner,
but the concerned police have arraigned all of them are accused.

Since the petitioner is not residing with accused No.1 and 2 and there are no specific allegation against him, this court of the considered opinion that continuation of the proceedings against him would amount to abuse of the process of the Court and it required to be quashed and accordingly, the following:
ORDER (i) Petition filed by petitioner/accused No.5 under Section 482 of Cr.P.C is hereby allowed.
